rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: An autonomous penetration testing server that provides nmap network scanning and searchsploit vulnerability discovery tools for security assessments. Built by alexgarabt, the implementation includes both a standalone agent that directly integrates security tools with Google's Gemini model, and an MCP server version that exposes the same capabilities through the Model Context Protocol for broader integration. Built with LangGraph for autonomous workflow orchestration, it automatically performs network reconnaissance, identifies running services and versions, then searches for known exploits across all discovered services to generate security reports. This makes it useful for automated vulnerability assessments, security auditing, and penetration testing workflows.
